This species occupies arid and semi-arid habitats across the southwestern United States and into Mexico, where it must cope with high daytime temperatures and limited water availability. The relatively modest metabolic rate likely represents an adaptation to such challenging environments, reducing endogenous heat production and conserving water through lower respiratory losses.
